label: COLLECTIVE_DIVERGENCE
fix_claim: Removed the per-rank sync override in config.yaml that made rank 0 use reduce+broadcast on the last bucket after warmup step 5 while peers used all_reduce; all ranks now use all_reduce so collectives match.
patch:
--- a/job/config.yaml
+++ b/job/config.yaml
@@ -12,6 +12,5 @@
   mode: all_reduce
   warmup_steps: 5
-  per_rank:
-    0: reduce_bcast
+  per_rank: {}
 data:
   root: data
